keyPoints: Dhwani (sound) vastuon ke kampan se paida hoti hai — bolte samay hamare swar-tantu kampan karte hain aur dhol ki khaal thokne par kampan karti hai.
Dhwani ko chalne ke liye madhyam chahiye — hawa, paani ya thos; chandrama par hawa nahi hai isiliye wahaan nirvat me dhwani nahi chalti.
Dhwani hawa me lagbhag 344 m/s ki chaal se chalti hai — roshni (3 lakh km/s) se bahut dheemi, isiliye bijli pehle dikhti hai garjana baad me sunai deti hai.
Taarvatva (pitch) aavritti par nirbhar karta hai — unchi aavritti se teekhi aawaz aur neechi aavritti se bhari aawaz nikalti hai.
Prakarsh (loudness) kampan ke aayam par nirbhar karta hai — jitna bada kampan, utni tez aawaz; ise decibel me naapa jaata hai.
20 Hz se kam (apshravya) aur 20,000 Hz se zyada (parashravya) dhwani manav kaan nahi sun sakta; kutte parashravya sun lete hain.
Aam galti: dhwani hamesha hawa me chalti hai ye manna; paani me dhwani hawa se chaar guna tez chalti hai, isiliye machhliyan door se sun leti hain.
